__doc: Suspected KFGQPC misprints in the official riwayah texts (scripts/rewayah/sources/SOURCES.md, Known upstream issues). The words DBs keep the official text and the highlight maps tint it as written. In the per-word readings index (build_readings_index.py) each listed member is read with its sibling narrator: it is placed in the sibling's group and its stored text is never shown as a reading of its own (row detail q). The app shows no note (decision: docs/plans/2026-11-14-word-study/README.md, Readings). Gate G7: every entry must still match the stored, tinted text exactly (code point for code point: the DB text is decomposed, alef + hamza above rather than U+0623) and name the rewayah's sibling, so a corrected source makes its entry fail until it is removed. A qualified reader signs these off with the review list (reading_review.md). Entries use file ids; location is the Hafs word slot.

issues.note: Qunbul 4:135 (Makki): fatha on the zay in both official Qunbul artifacts; Ibn Kathir reads the passive أُنزِلَ, as the official al-Bazzi text writes it.
Qalun 17:62: a sukun on the lam in both official Qalun JSONs; every reading, Warsh included, has قَالَ.
Warsh 43:58: no iqlab meem, so no tanween as written, in every official Warsh artifact; Nafi' reads jadalan, as the Qalun texts write it (جَدَلاَۢ).
al-Duri 43:78: a sukun on the dal of لَقَدْ (read clearly) before the doubled jim it merges into; Abu 'Amr merges the dal into the jim, as al-Susi's text writes it (لَقَد جِّينَٰكُم).
